minilm.description: Fast and lightweight — good for development and baseline comparison

mpnet.description: Stronger general-purpose model — good balance of quality and speed

e5.description: High quality retrieval model — best for production and final evaluation

bge.description: Strong retrieval-focused model — competitive with e5 on technical domains

otel-109m.description: Telecom-domain fine-tuned — 109M params, based on all-mpnet-base-v2

otel-300m.description: Telecom-domain fine-tuned — 300M params, based on Gemma3-Embedding-300M

otel-0.6b.description: Telecom-domain fine-tuned — 0.6B params, highest quality OTel embedder (recommended)

e5-prefixed.description: Opt-in variant of e5 that applies e5's documented 'query: ' / 'passage: ' prefixes. Separate key, so it never mixes with indexes built with plain 'e5'

bge-prefixed.description: Opt-in variant of bge that applies BGE's documented query instruction. Separate key, so it never mixes with indexes built with plain 'bge'
bge-prefixed.query_prefix: Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:

bge-m3.description: BAAI BGE-M3 (local sentence-transformers) — no query/document prefix required (verified 2026-09-21: HF model card confirms M3 dropped the instruction requirement earlier BGE versions had)

qwen3-embedding-0.6b.description: Qwen3 embedding series, 0.6B params — instruction-aware, strong general-purpose retrieval (verified 2026-09-21 via HF model card)
qwen3-embedding-0.6b.query_prefix:
Instruct: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query
Query:

qwen3-embedding-8b.description: Qwen3 embedding series, 8B params — largest Qwen3 embedding variant. Served via OpenRouter (--embed-backend openrouter), not local sentence-transformers, unlike qwen3-embedding-0.6b (verified live 2026-09-29: OpenRouter routes to DeepInfra, returns 4096-dim vectors, no Matryoshka truncation applied)
qwen3-embedding-8b.query_prefix:
Instruct: Given a web search query, retrieve relevant passages that answer the query
Query:

embeddinggemma-300m.description: Google EmbeddingGemma, 300M params — Matryoshka-truncatable to 512/256/128 dims, prompt-name-based query/document distinction (verified 2026-09-21 via HF model card + Google AI docs)

embeddinggemma-300m-fp32.description: The same model as embeddinggemma-300m, loaded in float32 without autocast: float16 can overflow to NaN vectors on some GPUs. A separate key, so its chunk ids and collection differ from embeddinggemma-300m
